patch_description: This replaces the direct-link-only score with a demand-weighted two-hop path-cover surrogate. For each origin–destination pair, it distributes a bounded share of credit across possible intermediate nodes, downweighting hubs with high estimated transit pressure. A pairwise coupling rewards selecting both links of a useful path, while smaller linear credits keep individual path links attractive. This should better represent traffic that must travel beyond direct links without letting the many possible two-hop paths overwhelm direct demand. The construction uses at most O(n³) quadratic terms.
